verdict.rationale: Derivative-model ecosystems are a fair axis for any AI model product, so this applies to Gemini. However, the evidence only describes a hosted API: SDKs, function calling, caching, pricing and terms. Nothing shows community replicas, fine-tunes or quantizations on public hubs, or any guidance on what is and isn't official. The OpenRouter mention is a reseller route to the same hosted model, not a derivative.
